UP-Term-perl: parts, licences and where the source is

Part                          Licence                          Source
----------------------------  -------------------------------  --------------------------------------------
Perl 5.42.3 (bin/perl)        Artistic 1.0 (Perl) or GPL v1 or later (licenses/perl) upterm-ports (pkgs/perl; perl-5.42.3.tar.gz)

Notes
- These files were part of UP-Term.lha until the slim base (P9); the package installs them at the
  same paths in UP-Term:. Its row of SOURCES.txt is in UP-Term:licenses/perl/SOURCES.txt.
- The complete source with UP-Term's patches and build recipes is UP-Term-src.lha, published next to
  UP-Term.lha.
